div.head: Hu 9
div.ab: Ferrum, quod facit ad triplex ordalium, debet ponderare LX solidos.
Ðæt isen, ðe bið to ðrimfealdum ordale, þæt wege III pund.
Ferrum triplicis Dei iudicii ponderet III libras.
Ðæt isen ðe bið to ðrimfealdum ordale, þæt wege III pund.
The iron for the triple ordeal shall weigh three pounds.
The iron which belongs to the three-fold ordeal is to weigh three pounds.
Das Eisen, welches zum dreifachen Ordale gehört, das wiege 3 Pfund.
The iron which belongs to the threefold ordeal is to weigh 3 pounds.
div.note: ‘and to anfaldum an pund’ was added in the margin of B in the 16th century (not in the archetype, as Quadr. and Cons. Cn. show). The Latin's ‘LX solidos’ = 3 pounds. In B, I Atr follows in the same hand; in Quadr., IV As.
